lines.trans: Viktor, we need to urgently talk about work.
Dima, the restaurant is full and all guests are happy.
Tonight I invited competitors over to our place.
Why are you inviting these strange people?
Our neighbor is opening a new restaurant next door.
We will prepare the very best dish for them.
They brought a new chef straight from India.
They would have done better finding a cook from Tajikistan.
You must greatly surprise our guests.
My signature cuisine will amaze absolutely everyone.
If you make a mistake, I will fire you immediately.
Do not worry, the chef always keeps his word.
